name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: Enables the deployment of a remote Model Context Protocol server to Cloudflare Workers without authentication. It allows users to define custom tools that can be accessed via SSE by clients like Claude Desktop or the Cloudflare AI Playground.
